_about: How rocknix-compare.py gets around in each UI (docs/COMPARE-ROCKNIX.md, 'The plan'). Sequences: buttons by their place on the Pocket (A right, B bottom, X top, Y left; UP DOWN LEFT RIGHT L R SELECT START HOME), HOME+X = hold HOME and press X, w500 = wait 500 ms, A:300 = hold 300 ms. Positions: 'start' is the start screen with the cursor on its first entry; a system's list has the cursor on the test game. Calibrated on the Mini V2 on 2026-10-26 (ROCKNIX 20261001, its 332 games; es-theme-art-book-next; pocket-ui main 9df5564 in the carousel look, German) with screenshots: another card's library needs other counts.
_brightness: the backlight while playing, the same for both: the owner's level (pocket-ui's saved level, 12 of 255)
